author: JayzTwoCents
description:
What really happens if you cheap out on your power supply?
In this video, we intentionally undersize a PSU and put it into a high-end gaming PC to see what actually happens under load. Does it just shut off? Does performance tank? Or can it silently damage your components over time?

We’ll stress test the system, monitor power draw, check for voltage instability, and talk about protections like OCP, OPP, and ripple — and whether they actually save your hardware. If you’ve ever wondered, “Is 750W enough?” or “Can a weak PSU hurt my GPU or CPU?” — this is the experiment you’ve been waiting for.

No fear-mongering. No brand bias. Just real results... 

If you're building a high-performance rig, overclocking, or pushing modern GPUs and CPUs to their limits, this is one component you don’t want to gamble on.
